His combination of assists, perimeter shooting and defensive production makes him a valuable category-league option while Portland remains shorthanded.

news.headline: Clingan closed with 22 points (9-11 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 1-1 FT), 13 rebounds, four assists, one block and one steal across 31 minutes during Saturday's 97-96 loss to New York.
news.story: Clingan was limited to just seven points on 2-for-5 shooting in Thursday's win over the Bucks, but he did a much better job of asserting himself in the offense Saturday and finished with a team-high 22 points. He also led his squad in rebounding, notched his seventh double-double of the season and finished with a plus-4 differential in the narrow defeat.

news.headline: Ingram registered 18 points (6-19 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 4-4 FT), five rebounds and four assists in 26 minutes during Wednesday's 115-97 loss to the Grizzlies.
news.story: Ingram struggled with his shooting touch again, but that's to be expected after missing the first 15 regular-season outings. In his two games since returning from a partially torn Achilles, Ingram is averaging 17.0 points, 6.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists in 26.5 minutes while shooting 32.4 percent (12-37 FG) from the field and 16.7 percent (2-12 3Pt) from behind the arc.

news.story: Ingram made his season debut and first appearance for the Clippers after undergoing surgery on his heel and partially torn Achilles tendon. news.headline: Ingram will start Monday's game against Houston.
news.story: Ingram has been cleared to make his 2026-27 season debut after recovering from a partially torn Achilles, and he'll do so as a member of the first unit. He'll presumably have his minutes monitored closely Monday, though the team hasn't shared how large of a workload he'll take on in his team debut.
